story-summary.user-story: As a system, I want an LLM-driven agent that executes fired triggers, So that proactive messages are contextual, relevant, and well-composed.
story-summary.description:
Implement the wake-up agent - an LLM-powered component that reads trigger action_context as a briefing, gathers fresh dynamic state, executes with full tool access, and either composes a personalized message or returns skip=True based on evaluation logic.
This is the core execution engine for the proactive AI system. It bridges the gap between trigger firing (time-based or condition-based) and message delivery, using the LLM to interpret complex user intent captured in action_context.

key-design-principles.principle: LLM-Driven Execution: The agent reads action_context as a briefing document, not as structured fields. This enables handling of novel trigger types without code changes.
Dynamic State Injection: Always fetch fresh context (current time, market status, recent conversations, fresh profile) on wake-up. Never trust stale data from action_context.
Full Tool Access: Agent has access to ALL read-only tools. Only restrict state-modifying tools (portfolio mutations, trigger mutations).
Skip Logic: Agent can return skip=True with reason. Not every trigger fire should send a message (e.g., "no meaningful portfolio change").
Tone Adjustment: Agent adjusts message tone based on recent conversation context (e.g., if user just messaged 5 minutes ago, be brief and casual).

criterion.name: Dynamic State Injection
criterion.then: Gathers fresh context: - Current datetime and day of week (in user's timezone) - Market status (open/closed/holiday) - Hours since user last messaged - Recent conversation summary (from agentic-memories, last 24h) - Fresh user profile (not from action_context)

criterion.name: Agent Prompt
criterion.then: Receives comprehensive prompt with: - Trigger metadata (name, type, fire_count, last_fired) - Dynamic state (current time, recent context, fresh profile) - Full action_context as briefing - Available tools list - Response format specification - Tone adjustment guidance based on recent_context

criterion.name: Dynamic Tool Access
criterion.then: - Queries MCP server fresh for complete tool list - Has access to ALL read-only tools - Only restricts state-modifying tools (add_holding, update_holding, remove_holding, create_trigger, delete_trigger) - No artificial limits on which tools can be used

criterion.name: Skip Logic
criterion.then: - Follows execution_instructions from briefing - Returns skip=True with reason when appropriate - Does not send message for skipped triggers

criterion.name: Message Composition
criterion.then: - Follows tone, length, include/exclude guidelines - References good/bad examples from briefing - Returns composed message - Adjusts tone based on recent_context

criterion.name: Response Format
criterion.then: Returns WakeUpResult with: - skip: bool - skip_reason: Optional[str] - message: Optional[str] - tools_called: List[str] - reasoning: str

criterion.name: Guardrails
criterion.then: Enforces: - 10 minute timeout (600 seconds) - Restricted tools list (no portfolio modification) - No hard limits on tool calls or message length

design-document.key-points: - Wake-up agent prompt template with all sections - Dynamic state gathering specification - Tool restriction list - Response format specification - Tone adjustment logic based on recent_context

pattern.name: LLM Client Usage
pattern.description: Use LLMClient for agent execution with streaming disabled (non-streaming mode preferred for agent execution to collect full response before parsing).
pattern.example:
# Import and initialize from api.llm_client import LLMClient
async with LLMClient() as llm_client: # Build messages list with system prompt and trigger context messages = [ {"role": "system", "content": agent_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": "Execute this trigger."} ]
# Get tools from MCP server async with MCPClient() as mcp_client: mcp_tools = await mcp_client.list_tools() tools = llm_client.convert_mcp_tools_to_functions(mcp_tools)
# Filter out restricted tools restricted = ["add_holding", "update_holding", "remove_holding", "create_trigger", "update_trigger", "delete_trigger"] allowed_tools = [t for t in tools if t["name"] not in restricted]
# Call LLM with non-streaming mode response = await llm_client.chat_completion( messages=messages, tools=allowed_tools, mcp_client=mcp_client )
# Extract response content content = response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

pattern.name: Tool Calling with MCP Client
pattern.description: Use MCPClient to fetch available tools and execute tool calls during agent execution. The MCP client handles tool execution and returns structured results.
pattern.example:
from api.mcp_client import MCPClient, MCPClientError, MCPToolError
async with MCPClient() as mcp_client: # List available tools tools = await mcp_client.list_tools()
# Execute a tool try: result = await mcp_client.call_tool( tool_name="get_portfolio", arguments={"user_id": user_id, "include_prices": True} ) # result is a dict with tool output except MCPToolError as e: # Handle tool execution error logger.error(f"Tool failed: {e.message}")

pattern.name: Langfuse Tracing
pattern.description: Use @observe decorator for tracing agent execution. All LLM calls and tool executions are automatically traced when using LLMClient and MCPClient.

pattern.name: Dynamic State Gathering
pattern.description: Gather fresh dynamic state on wake-up. Never trust stale data from action_context.
pattern.example:
from datetime import datetime import pytz from api.profile import ProfileManager from api.memory import MemoryManager
async def gather_dynamic_state(user_id: str, timezone: str) -> DynamicState: """Gather fresh dynamic context for wake-up agent."""
# Get current time in user's timezone user_tz = pytz.timezone(timezone) current_time = datetime.now(user_tz)
# Get market status (simple open/closed check) # Market hours: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET, Monday-Friday et_tz = pytz.timezone("America/New_York") et_time = datetime.now(et_tz) is_weekday = et_time.weekday() < 5 is_market_hours = 9 <= et_time.hour < 16 market_status = "open" if (is_weekday and is_market_hours) else "closed"
# Get hours since last user message (from Redis activity tracking) # Implementation depends on Story 13.8 (User Activity Tracking) hours_since_last_message = 0 # Placeholder
# Get recent conversation summary from agentic-memories memory_manager = MemoryManager() recent_context = await memory_manager.get_recent_context(user_id, hours=24)
# Get fresh user profile profile_manager = ProfileManager() profile = await profile_manager.get_profile(user_id, refresh=True)
return DynamicState( current_datetime=current_time, day_of_week=current_time.strftime("%A"), market_status=market_status, hours_since_last_message=hours_since_last_message, recent_context=recent_context, profile=profile )

pattern.name: Prompt Construction for Agent
pattern.description: Build comprehensive agent prompt with all required sections.
pattern.example:
def build_agent_prompt( trigger_data: Dict, dynamic_state: DynamicState, tools_list: List[str] ) -> str: """Build wake-up agent prompt with all sections."""
action_context = trigger_data.get("action_context", {})
prompt_parts = [ "You are the Wake-Up Agent for Annie, executing a proactive trigger.", "", "# TRIGGER METADATA", f"Trigger Name: {trigger_data.get('name', 'Unnamed')}", f"Trigger Type: {trigger_data['trigger_type']}", f"Fire Count: {trigger_data.get('fire_count', 0)}", f"Last Fired: {trigger_data.get('last_fired', 'Never')}", "", "# DYNAMIC STATE (Fresh Context)", f"Current Time: {dynamic_state.current_datetime.isoformat()}", f"Day of Week: {dynamic_state.day_of_week}", f"Market Status: {dynamic_state.market_status}", f"Hours Since User Last Messaged: {dynamic_state.hours_since_last_message}", "", "# RECENT CONVERSATION CONTEXT (Last 24h)", dynamic_state.recent_context or "No recent conversation history.", "", "# USER PROFILE (Fresh from agentic-memories)", str(dynamic_state.profile) if dynamic_state.profile else "No profile available.", "", "# ACTION CONTEXT (Briefing from Creation LLM)", "This is your briefing document. Follow its instructions carefully.", "", f"Original Request: {action_context.get('original_request', 'N/A')}", "", f"Intent Summary: {action_context.get('intent_summary', 'N/A')}", "", "User Context:", str(action_context.get('user_context', 'N/A')), "", "Execution Instructions:", action_context.get('execution_instructions', 'N/A'), "", "Message Guidance:", str(action_context.get('message_guidance', 'N/A')), "", "# AVAILABLE TOOLS", "You have access to the following tools:", ", ".join(tools_list), "", "# RESPONSE FORMAT", "Return a JSON object with:", "{", ' "skip": boolean, // True if should NOT send message', ' "skip_reason": string, // Required if skip=true', ' "message": string, // Required if skip=false', ' "tools_called": [list of tool names used],', ' "reasoning": string // Your decision-making process', "}", "", "# TONE ADJUSTMENT", f"Recent Contact: User messaged {dynamic_state.hours_since_last_message}h ago.", "If < 1h ago: Be brief and casual (they just talked to you).", "If 1-24h ago: Normal conversational tone.", "If > 24h ago: Warmer greeting, can be more detailed.", ]
return "\n".join(prompt_parts)

dev-notes.note: The wake-up agent is the CORE of the proactive AI system. All other components (gate, worker, delivery) exist to support it. Focus on making this agent robust and flexible.
Use non-streaming mode for agent execution to collect full response before parsing. This simplifies response parsing and allows for structured JSON output.
Tool orchestration: The agent may call multiple tools in sequence (e.g., get_portfolio, then get_stock_price for each ticker). Use the existing tool orchestration loop from stream.py as a reference.
Fresh state is CRITICAL. Never let the agent use stale portfolio data or profile data from action_context. Always fetch fresh on wake-up.
The action_context is a BRIEFING, not a schema. The agent should read it like a human would read instructions from a manager. This is the core of the LLM-driven architecture.
